courses.title: Monitoring and Evaluation in Practice
courses.description: Monitoring and Evaluation in Practice takes you from the basics of monitoring and evaluation to applying it on a realistic Executive Director scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to communication, enough to use it alongside monitoring and evaluation day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying monitoring and evaluation to a real Executive Director scenario
Practicing monitoring and evaluation through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to communication
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Fundraising and Grant Writing
courses.description: Applying Fundraising and Grant Writing goes beyond the basics of fundraising and grant writing, for people already working toward a Executive Director role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in fundraising and grant writing and want to go further.

courses.title: Getting Started with Budget Planning for Nonprofits
courses.description: Getting Started with Budget Planning for Nonprofits is a short introduction to budget planning for nonprofits for people moving toward a Executive Director role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show budget planning for nonprofits in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if budget planning for nonprofits is new to you.

alternates.title: Monitoring and Evaluation Essentials
alternates.description: Monitoring and Evaluation Essentials is a short introduction to monitoring and evaluation for people moving toward a Executive Director role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show monitoring and evaluation in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if monitoring and evaluation is new to you.

alternates.title: Advanced Monitoring and Evaluation Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Monitoring and Evaluation Techniques is a focused course on monitoring and evaluation for people already working toward a Executive Director role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying monitoring and evaluation on your own.
